title: Calibration Freeze and Cryptographic Receipt
objective: Freeze the retained calibration with a SHA-256 receipt before any holdout is scored; refuse post-freeze retuning.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.claims (FROZEN_PARAMETERS, refuse_post_output_retuning), cwatlas.r1082.config_authority (locked ADR freeze_hash), cwatlas.r1082.calibration_fit (P18), cwatlas.r1082.wilkes, cwatlas.r1082.partition (digest) - NOT reimplemented

implementation.seals: the 7 FROZEN_PARAMETERS (grid_rotation, handedness, root_feature, topology, tokenization, destination_label_split, epoch_choice) + profile id + two training-anchor hashes + fitted orientation angles per retained family
implementation.freeze_hash: SHA-256 over the canonical seal (deterministic; a clean checkout reproduces it)
implementation.created_at: passed-in ISO-8601 timestamp (never a wall-clock read)

negative_results: Freeze precedes holdout scoring: CalibrationSession.score_holdout raises CalibrationOrderError until freeze() has been called (no reverse-fitting to holdouts).

Post-freeze retuning is refused: FrozenCalibration.refuse_retune and CalibrationSession.retune (once frozen) route through claims.refuse_post_output_retuning (no result shopping); a different configuration is only expressible as a new profile id.
Tampering with a frozen parameter breaks the recomputed freeze hash (verify() returns False).
require_valid_receipt refuses source-map mode without a receipt naming EARTH_ROOT_D_V1, forbidding retuning, and carrying a freeze_hash.

claims.statement: The retained calibration is sealed with a deterministic SHA-256 receipt over the seven frozen parameters, the training-anchor hashes, and the fitted angles; freeze precedes holdout scoring and post-freeze retuning is refused.

privacy_check: CLEAN - opaque anchor ids and content hashes only; no private path literals, no personal identity tokens, no raw private vector or narrative
